table_integrity_findings.description: In original Table 7.1, columns were: [F1-Score, PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, MCC]. In audited Table 3.1, columns were: [F1-Score, MCC, PR-AUC, ROC-AUC]. In both tables, values strictly matched headers, but order differed.
table_integrity_findings.canonical_order: F1-Score | MCC | PR-AUC | ROC-AUC | Brier Score | ECE

table_integrity_findings.description: Table 4.1 in Gate 4.2 verified report displayed only 4 representative projects (batik, commons-exec, httpclient, httpcore). The other 5 validation projects were omitted from the table.
table_integrity_findings.recommendation: Expand Table 4.1 to display all 9 validation projects comprehensively in the Gate 4.3 report.

table_integrity_findings.description: Displaying '0.5000' or '*0.5000*' under ROC-AUC for commons-exec can mislead readers into interpreting 0.5 as an empirical measurement.
table_integrity_findings.recommendation: Format commons-exec ROC-AUC cell explicitly as 'N/A (0.5000*)' with footnote explaining 0.5000 is an imputation convention for macro averaging.

metric_semantics_classifications.justification: Actual positives = 0. Denominator TP + FN = 0. Mathematically undefined (0/0). Reported 0.00% is a REPORTING_CONVENTION.
Predicted positives = 7, True Positives = 0. Precision = 0 / 7 = 0.00% (Mathematically defined empirical zero due to false alarms).
Precision + Recall denominator is zero. Mathematically undefined. Reported 0.0000 is a REPORTING_CONVENTION.
Denominator sqrt((TP+FP)(TP+FN)(TN+FP)(TN+FN)) = 0. Mathematically undefined. Reported 0.0000 is a REPORTING_CONVENTION.
Mann-Whitney denominator N_pos * N_neg = 0. Mathematically undefined. 0.5000 is strictly an IMPUTED_FOR_AGGREGATION convention, NOT an empirical measurement.
No positive recall thresholds exist. Mathematically undefined. 0.0000 is strictly an IMPUTED_FOR_AGGREGATION convention.
Mean squared difference sum((p - 0)^2) / 600 = 0.0025. Strictly defined empirical loss.
10-bin expected calibration error. Strictly defined empirical calibration loss.
Mathematically undefined. 0.5000 is strictly an imputation convention.

statistical_claims_audit.required_wording: Must be described as an exploratory positive operational trade-off across 6 of 9 projects, NOT statistically significant at alpha=0.05.
Statistically significant decrease in F1 (p=0.0313*) demonstrating small-sample burn-in overreaction.
PR-AUC and ROC-AUC are strictly invariant under scalar log-odds adjustments.
